sections.Profile:
"America's Most Haunted" is the first production pinball machine by Spooky Pinball, released in April 2014 and limited to 150 units. Designed by Ben Heck with contributions from Dennis Nordman, the game features color-changing LEDs, a green DMD, and is powered by the PinHeck system. It offers a unique horror-themed experience with two flippers, two ramps, and a four-ball multiball.
